Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) ADDITIONAL TERMS & CONDITIONS (ATC) Innovation Art Installation & Wall Art Work Department: Forest Department, Maharashtra Project Location: Radhanagari – Dajipur – Rautwadi Taluka: Radhanagari, District Kolhapur, Maharashtra 1. Scope of Work The successful bidder shall undertake the complete execution of Innovation Art Instal lation and Wall Art Work at various locations identified by the Forest Department alo ng the Radhanagari–Dajipur–Rautwadi route. The scope shall include concept development, artistic design, site inspection, surface preparation, fabrication, painting, installation, transportation, labour, material procur ement, finishing and final handover. 2. Site Inspection 1. The bidder shall inspect the proposed work locations before commencement o f work. 2. The bidder shall assess the site conditions, dimensions, accessibility and instal lation requirements.

3. The bidder shall coordinate with the concerned Forest Department officials for identification and approval of locations. 4. No additional payment shall be admissible for failure to assess normal site con ditions before quoting. 3. Material and Workmanship 1. All materials used shall be of good quality, durable and suitable for outdoor ap plications. 2. Paints shall be weather-resistant, UV-resistant and suitable for exterior wall ap plications. 3. Fabricated structures shall have adequate strength, stability and corrosion pro tection. 4. All artwork shall have professional finishing, proper detailing and aesthetic ap peal. 5. Inferior-quality materials or defective workmanship shall be rectified or replac ed by the bidder at no additional cost. 4. Execution and Installation 1. The bidder shall arrange all necessary manpower, tools, equipment, transport ation and consumables. 2. The work shall be executed at various locations as directed by the Forest Dep artment. 3. The bidder shall ensure proper fixing, structural stability and safe installation of all artistic structures. 4. The bidder shall maintain cleanliness at the work locations and remove all deb ris after completion. 5. No damage shall be caused to existing trees, vegetation, wildlife habitats or g overnment property. 5. Forest and Environmental Permissions 1. All work shall be carried out strictly in accordance with applicable forest, wildli fe and environmental regulations. 2. The bidder shall not undertake excavation, tree cutting, vegetation removal or any activity affecting protected forest areas without written permission from th e competent authority. 3. Work inside restricted forest areas shall be undertaken only after obtaining th e required departmental approvals.

4. The bidder shall follow all safety and environmental instructions issued by the Forest Department. 6. Time Schedule 1. The successful bidder shall commence work within the period specified in the work order. 2. The complete work shall be executed within the delivery/completion period pr escribed in the GeM contract. 3. The bidder shall submit a work execution schedule for approval. 4. Any delay shall be reported to the concerned authority with valid justification. 7. Inspection and Quality Assurance 1. The Forest Department shall have the right to inspect the work at any stage. 2. The bidder shall provide samples, material specifications and design details w henever required. 3. Any defective, incomplete or non-conforming work shall be rectified by the bid der without additional cost. 4. Final acceptance shall be subject to satisfactory inspection and certification b y the competent authority. 8. Warranty and Maintenance 1. The bidder shall provide a minimum warranty of 12 months from the date of s atisfactory completion and acceptance. 2. Any peeling, fading, cracking, corrosion, detachment or workmanship-related defects during the warranty period shall be rectified free of cost. 3. The bidder shall ensure the stability and durability of all installed structures du ring the warranty period. 9. Payment Terms 1. Payment shall be released as per the GeM contract conditions and applicable government financial rules. 2. Payment shall be made against actual satisfactory execution and acceptance of work. 3. The bidder shall submit the required invoice, completion certificate, photograp hs and other supporting documents. 4. No payment shall be admissible for incomplete or rejected work.

10. Safety and Liability 1. The bidder shall be responsible for the safety of its workers and personnel duri ng execution. 2. The bidder shall provide necessary personal protective equipment (PPE) and s afety arrangements. 3. The bidder shall be responsible for any damage caused to government propert y due to negligence during execution. 4. The bidder shall comply with applicable labour laws and statutory requirement s. 12. General Conditions 1. The bidder shall not subcontract the work without prior written approval of the competent authority, subject to applicable GeM conditions. 2. The Forest Department reserves the right to reject work not meeting the appr oved design or quality standards. 3. Any deviation from the approved scope shall require prior written approval. 4. All statutory taxes, duties, transportation, labour and incidental expenses shal l be deemed included in the quoted rates unless specifically provided otherwis e. 5. All other terms and conditions shall be governed by the GeM General Terms a nd Conditions (GTC) and applicable government procurement rules. 9. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses DOCUMENTS REQUIRED WITH THE TECHNICAL BID The bidder shall submit the following documents along with the technical bid. Failure to submit the required documents may result in rejection of the bid, subject to applic able GeM provisions. 1. Financial Standing Certificate 2. Non-Blacklisting Declaration 3. Integrity Pact · The bidder shall submit a duly signed and stamped Integrity Pact as per the for mat attached with the bid document. · The Integrity Pact shall be signed by the authorised signatory of the bidding fir

m. 4. Chartered Accountant (CA) Certificate · The bidder shall submit a certificate issued by a practising Chartered Accounta nt containing the required financial details of the firm/company. · The certificate shall be valid and relevant to the financial information requeste d in the bid. GENERAL INSTRUCTIONS 1. All documents shall be self-attested by the authorised signatory wherever app licable. 2. All certificates and declarations must be legible and valid. 3. The buyer reserves the right to verify the authenticity of the submitted docum ents. 4. Non-submission of mandatory documents or submission of false information m ay lead to rejection of the bid and further action as per applicable GeM terms a nd conditions. .
